text: You want to modify two items in an order you just received: a coffee machine and a laptop. For the coffee machine, you want to keep the capacity and type but change the pressure lower to 8 bar. If 8 bar is not possible, you want 9 bar. If 9 bar is not possible, you want 7 bar. If 7, 8, 9 are not possible, no exchange for the coffee machine. For the laptop, you want to exchange to the cheapest i7 or above, and you do not care about other specs. If a price difference is needed to pay, you would be angry but prefer gift card payment. If that is not possible, you would use the credit card.
zh: 您想修改刚收到的订单中的两个商品：一台咖啡机和一台笔记本电脑。对于咖啡机，您想保持容量和类型不变，但将压力调低至8个大气压。如果8个大气压不行，您想要9个大气压。如果9个大气压也不行，您想要7个大气压。如果7、8、9个大气压都不行，咖啡机就不换了。对于笔记本电脑，您想换成最便宜的i7或更高型号的，其他规格您不在意。如果需要补差价，您会生气但更倾向于礼品卡支付。如果那也不行，您会使用信用卡。(订单号 #W1234567，商品号 #C89012，咖啡机，容量，类型，压力；商品号 #L45678，笔记本电脑，i7)
